text:
guys I found a tool to protect your art from being scraped by ai! 

it's called mist, available entirely for free and open source and it's gonna be the basis of the crowdfunded anti ai social media Haven!

it embeds a watermark invisible to the human eye that distorts ai output when the art is used for training or image2image creation, like the reverse of synthID basically

I'm so so happy to see tech and art come together to fight against theft and soulless synthetic creations 🌸
